name: Household Knowledge
description: Paint colors, appliance models, measurements, and other household facts you forget
agent_instructions: This collection stores household facts the user wants to remember — paint colors, appliance models, measurements, warranties. When the user mentions one of these in conversation (a paint brand, a model number, a measurement, an item they bought for the house), offer to add an entry. Always capture brand/model and purchase date if available. Confirm before the first capture in a session.

name: Home Maintenance
description: Track home assets, vendors, service dates, costs, notes, and warranties.
agent_instructions: Capture entries when the user mentions repairs, maintenance visits, appliance details, contractors, warranties, or home assets that may matter later. Extract the asset, vendor or service person, service date, cost, notes, and any warranty expiration automatically when stated. Ask a brief follow-up if a warranty, next service date, or vendor name is implied but missing. Pay special attention to time-bridging warnings: if a warranty is near expiry, a service date suggests recurring maintenance, or a cost/vendor detail could help future troubleshooting, preserve it clearly.

name: Job Applications
description: Track roles, companies, statuses, application dates, compensation ranges, contacts, and notes.
agent_instructions: Capture entries when the user mentions applying to a role, hearing back from a company, scheduling interviews, receiving offers or rejections, or discussing a job lead. Extract company, role, status, applied date, salary range, contact, and notes when stated. Watch for follow-up cadence signals like recruiter replies, interview timing, deadlines, and next steps, and suggest capturing follow-up context when useful. Detect warm intro opportunities when the user mentions a person connected to the company or role.

name: Workout Log
description: Log workouts with date, type, duration, feelings, and exercise details.
agent_instructions: Capture entries when the user casually mentions completing a workout, exercise session, run, class, sport, stretch, or training block. Keep capture low-friction: infer date, type, duration, exercises, and how the user felt from natural phrasing without asking for perfect detail. Ask only one concise follow-up if the core workout type or date is missing. Prefer preserving imperfect notes over interrupting the user with too many questions.

name: Wine Journal
description: Remember wines, vintages, regions, where you had them, ratings, and tasting notes.
agent_instructions: Capture entries when the user mentions drinking, buying, tasting, liking, disliking, or wanting to remember a specific wine. Extract the wine name, vintage, region, location, date, rating, and tasting notes when available. Ask a short follow-up only if the wine name is unclear or the user seems to want a rating but did not give one. Preserve subjective impressions and context because they are often more useful than formal tasting vocabulary.

name: Books
description: Books you want to read, are reading, and have finished, with your rating and notes
agent_instructions: Keep track of books the user mentions wanting to read, starting, finishing, or giving up on. Fill in the title, author, status, genre, rating, the date they finished, and their own notes when they give them. Update an existing book rather than adding it twice. Confirm with the user before the first capture in a session.

name: Recipes
description: Recipes you cook or want to try: ingredients, steps, time and where they came from
agent_instructions: Capture recipes the user cooks, shares, or wants to try. Fill in the name, course, cuisine, total time, servings, ingredients, steps, and the link or book it came from when available. Keep the user's own changes to a recipe in the steps. Confirm with the user before the first capture in a session.

name: Movies
description: Films you want to watch and have watched, with your rating and notes
agent_instructions: Keep track of films the user mentions wanting to watch or having watched. Fill in the title, year, director, status, rating, the date they watched it, where to watch it, and their own notes when they give them. Update an existing film rather than adding it twice. Confirm with the user before the first capture in a session.
